title: Anti AFKSpy
features:
Reuploaded on Script-Ware Catalogue for more Discovery

Any ROBLOX game can detect when you're not focused on the game client.
(examples: Group Recruiting Plaza, Teethyz Dentist)
This stops that.

This requires an exploit that can get connections and fire signals.
script:
function disableAllConnections(event:RBXScriptSignal)
	local a = getconnections(event)
	for _,v in pairs(a) do
		v:Disable()
	end
end

firesignal(game:GetService("UserInputService").WindowFocused)

while wait() do
	disableAllConnections(game:GetService("UserInputService").WindowFocusReleased)
end
